$comment: GaaS platform sheet for `gaas new` then `casals sheet deploy` onto **GaaS Casals** only. Conductor canisters (casals_backend, casals_frontend, casals_file_registry) are created by `casals new` (always destroy-and-recreate), not this sheet. Registry vs installer are separate stands (same-stand backend+frontend on a lumped platform stand tripped ManagePermissions). No infra baton: batons are per-realm and are minted with the realm (see the Deployments section, e.g. <slug>-baton, which really does hold IC control of that realm's canisters). A single baton in front of installer + realm-registry only duplicated Casals's own commander plus the governance multisig and never became a controller of either canister. Deployments commander (the installer principal) is applied after mint via set_commander. realm-registry-frontend is DNS keep-ID (*.gos.earth): reinstall on the same principal is OK; do not delete_canister. Empty Deployments is intentional: gaas new destroys realm/quarter canisters and does not recreate them. Fleet file-registry is Product-owned (realms/casals.json), not an Infra stand. realms seed deploys realms/casals.json onto a separate Realms GOS Casals instance.
name: gaas
description: GaaS *.gos.earth platform: governance, installer, realm registry. Deployments start empty.

sections.name: Infra
sections.description: Orchestration governance (multisig) and GaaS portal canisters (installer, realm registry).

stands.name: governance
stands.description: Root multisig for platform and baton IC control. Signers configured post-deploy.

stands.name: installer
stands.description: Realm installer backend. Granted Deployments section commander after mint.

stands.name: realm-registry
stands.description: Realm registry backend and DNS-mapped frontend (*.gos.earth keep-ID; reinstall OK).

sections.name: Deployments
sections.description: Realm stands (created later by realm_installer). Empty on purpose for a full rebuild: gaas new destroys existing realm/quarter canisters. Installer is granted section commander after sheet deploy.
